edits.after: Weaver's Wall runs a 180-second cooldown — pre-place it for roams and cutoffs; a panic cast mid-fight walls out your own team.

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
